lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BIGLANG DUMILIM ANG PANINGIN MO! Dahil sa sobrang puyat at pagod, nilagnat ka at hinimatay pag-uwi mo.
lines.textEn: YOUR VISION SUDDENLY TUNNELS DARK! From nonstop exhaustion and sleeplessness, a high fever knocks you out flat the moment you get home.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Diyos ko, {name}! Ang init ng noo mo! Magpahinga ka muna — eto, lugaw at paracetamol. Walang kwenta ang grado kung bibigay katawan mo!
lines.textEn: Goodness, {name}! You are burning up! Forced bedrest right now — here is hot lugaw and medicine. Grades mean nothing if your body collapses!

choices.text: Mag-forced rest at uminom ng gamot (-₱180 gamot, +45 Energy, +10 Mental).
choices.textEn: Take forced bedrest and medicine (-₱180 meds, +45 Energy, +10 Mental).

journal.title: Forced Rest (Nilagnat sa Pagod)
journal.summary: Bumigay ang katawan mo sa sobrang puyat. Inalagaan ka ni Aling Nena ng lugaw.
journal.summaryEn: Your body forced a shutdown from exhaustion. Aling Nena looked after you with hot lugaw.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BURNOUT CRISIS. Nakatitig ka sa kisame nang alas-tres ng madaling araw. Parang kahit anong kayod mo, hindi nauubos ang gastusin at deadlines.
lines.textEn: BURNOUT CRISIS. Staring at the ceiling at 3 AM. No matter how hard you push, the bills and deadlines never stop coming.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak... narinig kita sa phone kanina na umiiyak. Pwede kang magpahinga kahit sandali — o kung kailangan mo nang umuwi muna para mag-Leave of Absence, tanggap ka namin.
lines.textEn: Anak... I heard you crying on the phone earlier. Please pause and breathe — or if you need to take a Leave of Absence and come home, our arms are open.

choices.text: Huminga nang malalim, kausapin si Mama at ang barkada — lalaban pa ako! (+35 Mental)
choices.textEn: Breathe deeply, talk it out with Mama and friends — I will recover and keep going! (+35 Mental)

journal.title: Burnout Scare
journal.summary: Muntik ka nang bumigay sa stress, pero binigyan ka ng lakas ng pamilya at barkada.
journal.summaryEn: You nearly broke under burnout, until family and friends helped pull you back.

choices.text: Mag-file ng Leave of Absence (LOA) at umuwi muna sa {hometown} para magpagaling.
choices.textEn: File a Leave of Absence (LOA) and head home to {hometown} to heal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: SIGNAL NO. 2! Baha hanggang tuhod sa kanto at walang pasok — pero naka-schedule ang part-time shift at quiz bukas!
lines.textEn: TYPHOON SIGNAL NO. 2! Knee-deep floodwaters outside and classes are suspended — but your shift and tomorrow's quiz still loom!

choices.text: Manatili sa loob, mag-luto ng Lucky Me noodles at mag-review (+GWA, +Energy, -₱40).
choices.textEn: Stay dry inside, cook instant noodles, and review (+GWA, +Energy, -₱40).

choices.text: Sumulong sa baha para sa emergency shift (+₱300, -Energy, -Mental).
choices.textEn: Wade through the flood for an emergency shift (+₱300, -Energy, -Mental).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BROWNOUT ALERT! Namatay ang Wi-Fi at electric fan 30 minutes bago deadline ng online quiz! Init na init ka na!
lines.textEn: BROWNOUT ALERT! Wi-Fi and fan cut out 30 minutes before an online quiz deadline! Sweltering tropical heat instantly fills the room!

choices.text: Mag-load ng ₱50 emergency promo data at ipasa on time!
choices.textEn: Top up ₱50 prepaid mobile data and submit on time!

choices.text: Mag-email kay Prof gamit ang screenshot ng brownout advisory (Free, risky).
choices.textEn: Message Prof with a screenshot of the brownout advisory (Free).

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Nagtaas na naman ng ₱2 ang pamasahe sa jeep! Kahit may student discount, dama pa rin sa lingguhang budget!
lines.textEn: Jeepney minimum fare jumped another ₱2! Even with the student discount, our weekly budget feels it!

choices.text: Maglakad na lang mula kanto pauwi para makatipid (-Energy, +₱60 saved).
choices.textEn: Walk the last two kilometers home to save fare (-Energy, save ₱60).

choices.text: Sumakay pa rin para hindi ma-late (-₱90).
choices.textEn: Pay the fare anyway so you don't arrive exhausted (-₱90).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Hindi na naman nag-ambag ng slides 'yung groupmate natin! 'Pasensya na guys, may family outing kami' daw — 2 hours bago presentation!
lines.textEn: Our groupmate skipped their slides again! Claimed 'sorry guys, sudden family outing' — 2 hours before presentation!

choices.text: Buhatin ang part niya para hindi bumagsak ang grupo (-Energy, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Carry their section so the group keeps an A (-Energy, +GWA).

choices.text: I-report nang patas sa peer evaluation at gawin lang ang parte mo.
choices.textEn: Grade honestly on peer evaluation and protect your own rest.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, nasugod saglit sa clinic ang bunso / lolo mo dahil sa hika. Okay na siya pero kinulang kami sa pambili ng gamot...
lines.textEn: Anak, we had a sudden clinic visit back home for asthma meds. Everyone is stable now, just short on the prescription...

choices.text: Magpadala agad ng ₱400 sa GCash / remittance para makatulong!
choices.textEn: Send ₱400 right away to help cover the prescription!

choices.text: Magpadala ng ₱150 at mag-video call para pakalmahin si Mama.
choices.textEn: Send ₱150 and video call to comfort Mama.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Achoo! Sinisipon at masakit ang lalamunan mo dahil sa pabago-bagong init at ulan sa commute.
lines.textEn: Achoo! You caught a cold and sore throat from alternating scorching sun and sudden rain on your commute.

choices.text: Bumili ng Bioflu, calamansi, at magpahinga (-₱95, +Energy).
choices.textEn: Buy cold meds, calamansi juice, and rest (-₱95, +Energy).

choices.text: Inom na lang ng mainit na tubig at pumasok pa rin (-Energy, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Drink hot water and power through class (-Energy, +GWA).

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: ₱5 per page ang color print sa tapat ng gate?! Tapos 24 pages 'yung lab manual?! Ginto ba ang ink nila?!
lines.textEn: ₱5 per page for color printing across the gate?! On a 24-page lab manual?! Is their ink liquid gold?!

choices.text: I-print nang buo para kumpleto ang requirements (-₱120, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Print the full manual for neat requirements (-₱120, +GWA).

choices.text: 2-slides-per-page grayscale + back-to-back diskarte (-₱35).
choices.textEn: 2-up grayscale double-sided master strategy (-₱35).

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Birthday ng apo ko ngayon, {name}! Libre ang pancit bihon at lumpia para sa mga suking estudyante!
lines.textEn: It is my grandchild's birthday today, {name}! Free pancit bihon and lumpia for loyal students!

choices.text: Makikain at bumati nang masaya! (+Energy, +Mental, +Aling Nena)
choices.textEn: Join the feast and greet her warmly! (+Energy, +Mental, +Aling Nena)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: May napulot kang coin purse malapit sa waiting shed — may ₱300 sa loob at student ID ng isang transferee.
lines.textEn: You spot a dropped coin purse by the waiting shed — ₱300 inside and a freshman's school ID.

choices.text: Ibalik agad sa Student Affairs / may-ari!
choices.textEn: Return it immediately to Student Affairs / the owner!

choices.text: Ibalik ang ID at coin purse pero tahimik na umalis bago pa siya makapag-reward.
choices.textEn: Turn it in quietly without waiting for a reward.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Get 1/4 sheet of pad paper! Surprise quiz — 10 items lang naman!
lines.textEn: Get a 1/4 sheet of pad paper! Surprise quiz — just 10 quick items!

choices.text: Mag-share ng 1/4 pad paper sa katabi at sumagot nang confident!
choices.textEn: Share 1/4 paper with your seatmate and ace the quiz!

choices.text: Focus lang nang todo — kailangan perfect para sa GWA!
choices.textEn: Lock in completely — aiming for 10/10!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Naku po! Bumuka ang swelas ng black school shoes mo habang tumatawid sa overpass! Parang buwaya na tuwing naglalakad ka!
lines.textEn: Oh no! The sole of your black school shoes split wide open on the footbridge! Flapping like a crocodile with every step!

choices.text: Ipatahi kay Manong Sapatero sa kanto (-₱80, matibay!).
choices.textEn: Have Manong Cobbler stitch it up at the corner (-₱80, built to last!).

choices.text: Bumili ng Mighty Bond at idikit sa dorm (-₱30).
choices.textEn: Buy superglue and DIY fix it at home (-₱30).

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: May barangay fiesta gig ang banda namin tonight! Kailangan ng tech/ticket crew — ₱250 plus unli barbecue!
lines.textEn: Our band has a barangay fiesta gig tonight! Need ticket/gear crew — ₱250 plus unlimited barbecue!

choices.text: Tara! Extra kita plus libreng dinner! (+₱250, +Social, -Energy)
choices.textEn: Count me in! Cash plus free dinner! (+₱250, +Social, -Energy)

choices.text: Pass muna — review night ako.
choices.textEn: Pass — sticking to review night.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: Walang tubig hanggang mamayang gabi! Nag-igib ako ng dalawang drum — tipid sa tabo ha!
lines.textEn: Water interruption until tonight! I stored two drums — strictly bucket-bath rationing today!

choices.text: Tumulong mag-igib ng timba para kay Aling Nena (-Energy, ++Aling Nena).
choices.textEn: Help haul water buckets for Aling Nena (-Energy, ++Aling Nena).

choices.text: Mag-wisik-wisik lang at magmadali sa klase.
choices.textEn: Quick splash and dash straight to class.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: JACKPOT! Pinamana sa atin ng alumni 'yung complete highlighted reviewer at sample problems para sa major natin!
lines.textEn: JACKPOT! An alumnus just passed down their complete highlighted reviewer and solved problem set!

choices.text: Aralin agad kasama si Bea! (+GWA, +Bea)
choices.textEn: Dive right into it with Bea! (+GWA, +Bea)

lines.speaker: Regular Customer
lines.text: Working student ka pala, iho/iha! Ang sipag mo naman — eto, maliit na aguinaldo para sa pambili mo ng libro at baon!
lines.textEn: You are a working student! Such great work ethic — here is a little holiday tip for your books and meals!

choices.text: Magpasalamat nang buong puso! (+₱300, +Mental)
choices.textEn: Thank them with all your heart! (+₱300, +Mental)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bumper-to-bumper ang traffic! Isang oras nang hindi gumagalaw ang jeep at 20 minutes na lang bago mag-check ng attendance!
lines.textEn: Total gridlock! The jeepney has not moved in 45 minutes and attendance starts in 20 minutes!

choices.text: Bumaba at mag-power walk / takbo hanggang gate (-Energy, on time!).
choices.textEn: Hop off and power-walk all the way to campus (-Energy, on time!).

choices.text: Mag-angkas / tricycle shortcut (-₱90, walang pawis!).
choices.textEn: Take a quick tricycle shortcut (-₱90, arrive fresh!).

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: May iniwan akong iced coffee at sticky note sa desk mo: 'Kaya mo 'yan, {name}! Huwag kalimutan kumain!'
lines.textEn: I left an iced coffee and a sticky note on your desk: 'You got this, {name}! Do not skip lunch!'

choices.text: Ngumiti nang malaki at sabayan si Jamie mag-merienda! (+Energy, ++Mental, +Jamie)
choices.textEn: Beam warmly and share merienda with Jamie! (+Energy, ++Mental, +Jamie)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nag-spark at tuluyang nasira ang lumang phone charger cable mo! Kailangan mo ng charger para sa class GC at alarms.
lines.textEn: Your battered charging cable finally sparked and died! You need it for class group chats and your 5 AM alarm.

choices.text: Bumili ng maayos na braided cable sa tiangge (-₱130).
choices.textEn: Buy a sturdy braided cable at the stall (-₱130).

choices.text: Makihiram muna sa spare charger ni Miggy (+Miggy).
choices.textEn: Borrow Miggy's spare cable for the week (+Miggy).

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Uy, bagong luto 'yung kwek-kwek, kikiam, at palamig kay Kuya! ₱30 lang busog na!
lines.textEn: Fresh batch of crispy kwek-kwek, kikiam, and cold gulaman at Kuya's cart! Just ₱30!

choices.text: Tusok-tusok break! (-₱30, +Energy, +Mental)
choices.textEn: Street food break! (-₱30, +Energy, +Mental)

choices.text: Tiyaga muna sa tubig — nag-iipon ako!
choices.textEn: Stick to water — staying strict on savings!

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: GOOD NEWS! May faculty conference daw kaya cancelled ang 3-hour major class natin ngayong hapon!
lines.textEn: GOOD NEWS! Faculty conference today — our 3-hour afternoon lecture is cancelled!

choices.text: Gamitin ang libreng 3 oras para matulog nang mahimbing (+20 Energy, +10 Mental).
choices.textEn: Use the free 3 hours for a legendary nap (+20 Energy, +10 Mental).

choices.text: Mag-squeeze in ng quick part-time shift! (Play Carinderia Rush)
choices.textEn: Squeeze in an unscheduled shift! (Play Carinderia Rush)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bundok na ang labahan mo at isa na lang ang malinis na uniform polo mo para bukas!
lines.textEn: Your laundry pile is now a mountain and you have one clean uniform left for tomorrow!

choices.text: Mag-handwash nang gabi para tipid (-Energy, Free).
choices.textEn: Handwash tonight to save cash (-Energy, Free).

choices.text: Ipa-laundry shop sa kanto (-₱135, bawi sa pahinga!).
choices.textEn: Drop it at the corner laundry shop (-₱135, save your back!).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: SPLASH! Natalsikan ng spaghetti sauce ang puting uniform mo 15 minutes bago presentation!
lines.textEn: SPLASH! Red spaghetti sauce just landed squarely on your crisp white uniform 15 minutes before presentation!

choices.text: Hiramin ang extra hoodie/blazer ni Miggy at tawanan na lang!
choices.textEn: Borrow Miggy's spare jacket and laugh it off!

lines.speaker: Neighbor Parent
lines.text: {name}, pwede mo bang i-tutor ng 1 hour ang anak ko sa Math/English quiz niya bukas? May bayad at merienda!
lines.textEn: {name}, could you tutor my kid for an hour before tomorrow's quiz? Paid plus snacks!

choices.text: Oo naman po! (Play Tutoring Quiz)
choices.textEn: Of course! (Play Tutoring Quiz)

choices.text: Next weekend na lang po, tambak ng requirements ngayon.
choices.textEn: Next weekend please, buried in coursework right now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 38°C sa labas pero parang Baguio sa lamig ng aircon sa 3rd floor ng library! Nakahanap ka ng tahimik na corner table.
lines.textEn: 38°C outside, yet the 3rd-floor library AC feels like Baguio! You snag a quiet corner desk.

choices.text: Mag-20 minute power nap tapos 2 hours focused study (+Energy, +GWA).
choices.textEn: 20-minute power nap followed by 2 hours of deep study (+Energy, +GWA).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Habang naglilinis ng bag at lumang pantalon, nakakita ka ng nakalimutang ₱200 bill at sandamakmak na ₱10 coins!
lines.textEn: While cleaning out an old jacket and backpack pocket, you uncover a forgotten ₱200 bill and a handful of ₱10 coins!

choices.text: Hallelujah! Diretso sa savings jar! (+₱260, +Mental)
choices.textEn: Hallelujah! Straight into the emergency fund! (+₱260, +Mental)

lines.speaker: Jeepney Driver
lines.text: Sabado ngayon ah — pero sige, may ID ka naman at naka-lanyard, bibigyan pa rin kita ng student discount! Aral nang mabuti ha!
lines.textEn: It is Saturday — but I see your school ID, so I will still honor your student discount! Study hard, kid!

choices.text: 'Salamat po, Manong! Ingat po sa biyahe!' (+Mental, +₱25 saved)
choices.textEn: 'Thank you so much, Manong! Drive safely!' (+Mental, +₱25 saved)

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Guys, ambagan daw ng ₱50 para sa floor wax, whiteboard markers, at electric fan repair ng classroom natin.
lines.textEn: Hey class, ₱50 contribution for floor wax, whiteboard markers, and fixing the noisy classroom wall fan.

choices.text: Mag-ambag ng ₱50 para hindi na mainit sa klase (-₱50, +Social).
choices.textEn: Chip in ₱50 so the classroom stays cool (-₱50, +Social).

choices.text: Mag-volunteer na lang maglinis at mag-ayos ng fan nang libre (-Energy, +Social).
choices.textEn: Volunteer to clean and help fix the fan instead (-Energy, +Social).

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Tingnan mo 'yung chubby campus cat sa tabi ng gate! Nagpapa-pet sa lahat ng stressed na estudyante!
lines.textEn: Look at the chubby campus cat by the gate! Letting stressed students pet it between exams!

choices.text: Bumili ng ₱20 cat treats at mag-pet session kasama si Jamie! (+Mental, +Jamie)
choices.textEn: Buy ₱20 cat treats and pet the cat with Jamie! (+Mental, +Jamie)

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: May bagong libreng student Wi-Fi hub sa barangay hall! Mabilis mag-download ng lecture PDFs at reviewers!
lines.textEn: The barangay hall just launched a free student Wi-Fi corner! Fast enough to download all your lecture PDFs!

choices.text: I-download lahat ng offline reviewers para hindi na magastos sa load (+₱80 saved, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Download all readings offline to save prepaid data (+₱80 saved, +GWA).

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Bonus opportunity! Sinuman ang magpapasa ng 2-page critical reflection bukas ay may plus 5 points sa major exam!
lines.textEn: Bonus opportunity! Anyone submitting a 2-page critical reflection tomorrow earns +5 bonus points on the major exam!

choices.text: Gawin mamayang gabi — bawat puntos mahalaga! (-Energy, ++GWA)
choices.textEn: Write it tonight — every point counts! (-Energy, ++GWA)

choices.text: Pass muna — kailangan ko matulog nang maaga.
choices.textEn: Skip it — sleep is non-negotiable tonight.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Uy, ang daming naghahanap ng murang ID laces, pastel highlighters, at mini electric fans ngayong tag-init! Mag-pre-order batch kaya tayo?
lines.textEn: Everyone is hunting for cheap ID lanyards, highlighters, and mini USB fans in this heat! Want to run a quick pre-order batch?

choices.text: G! Patakbuhin ang student side-hustle! (Play Tusok-Tusok)
choices.textEn: Let us run the mini pre-order batch! (Play Selling Game)

choices.text: Sige, i-post ko lang sa GC para sa small referral cut (+₱160).
choices.textEn: Share it in the class chat for a small referral cut (+₱160).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Kulay kahel at ginto ang langit sa paglubog ng araw habang naglalakad ka pauwi. Nakakapagod ang linggo, pero naramdaman mong malayo na rin ang narating mo.
lines.textEn: The evening sky burns orange and gold on your walk home. The week was heavy, yet for a quiet moment you realize how far you have already come.

choices.text: Huminga nang malalim at magpatuloy nang may pag-asa (+14 Mental).
choices.textEn: Take a deep breath and carry on with hope (+14 Mental).
